name: Dog Trot 2
source:
a small visual novel based in louisville kentucky. vin left for college but is struggling with leaving her friends behind. help her get to class on time and maybe make friends and socialise. it's totally fine if u don't tho...

[From [url=https://pigeoncubed.itch.io/dog-trot-2]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以肯塔基州路易斯维尔为背景的小型视觉小说。文去上大学了，但她正在努力摆脱她的朋友们。帮助她准时上课，或许还能结交朋友和进行社交活动。如果你不这样做也没关系…

[来自[url=https://pigeoncubed.itch.io/dog-trot-2]itch.io[/url]]
